modeHelp.flat: The same units on every pick, win or lose.
modeHelp.percent: A percentage of the bankroll, which grows and shrinks with the results. Same-day picks are staked on the bankroll at the start of that day, because they are placed before any of them settles.
modeHelp.staked: The stake each pick was logged with: real bets use the sheet's stake and profit; Grok his suggested stake. Picks without a stake (Shadow) are left out.
modeHelp.kelly: Fractional Kelly from the logged fair probability and the price, on the bankroll at the start of the day and capped per pick. A pick with no edge gets stake 0 and is not placed.

percentField: Percentage of the bankroll per pick
bankHintFlat: Only used to measure the worst drop as a % of the bankroll.
bankHint: By default, your Settings bankroll in units (or 100u if you have not set it).

lead.percent: Had you bet {pct}% of the bankroll on each
lead.staked: With the stake each was logged with

close.no_close: None of these picks has a close with both sides, so the price cannot be judged against the close yet.

lucky.one: On the one pick with a two-sided close you won {actual}, but against the close the price was worth {expected}: the result may still be luck.
lucky.other: On the {n} picks with a two-sided close you won {actual}, but against the close the price was worth {expected}: the result may still be luck.

backed.one: On the one pick with a two-sided close you won {actual} and the price backs it: against the close it was worth {expected} ({lo} to {hi}).
backed.other: On the {n} picks with a two-sided close you won {actual} and the price backs it: against the close it was worth {expected} ({lo} to {hi}).

backed_weak.one: On the one pick with a two-sided close you won {actual} and against the close the price was worth {expected}, but the range still includes zero: the sample is short.
backed_weak.other: On the {n} picks with a two-sided close you won {actual} and against the close the price was worth {expected}, but the range ({lo} to {hi}) still includes zero: the sample is short.

unlucky.one: On the one pick with a two-sided close you lost {actualAbs}, but against the close the price was worth {expected}: it may be bad luck rather than bad prices.
unlucky.other: On the {n} picks with a two-sided close you lost {actualAbs}, but against the close the price was worth {expected}: it may be bad luck rather than bad prices.

deserved.one: On the one pick with a two-sided close you lost {actualAbs} and against the close the price was not worth it either ({expected}): it is not just bad luck.
deserved.other: On the {n} picks with a two-sided close you lost {actualAbs} and against the close the price was not worth it either ({expected}): it is not just bad luck.

noStake.one: {n} pick without a stake was left out.
noStake.other: {n} picks without a stake were left out.

noProb.other: {n} picks without a logged probability were left out of Kelly.

zeroStake.one: {n} pick with no edge got stake 0 and was not placed.
zeroStake.other: {n} picks with no edge got stake 0 and were not placed.

unpriced.one: {n} graded pick without a price does not count.
unpriced.other: {n} graded picks without a price do not count.

curveExpected: Against the close, the price was worth {expected}.

risk.title: Drops and streaks
risk.summary: worst drop {dd} · {loss} losses in a row
risk.note: The worst drop runs from the highest point of the curve to the lowest one after it. Voids and halves do not break a streak.

price.title: What the price says
price.intro: A result can be luck; the close without the margin says what each price was worth. This adds up, with the same stakes, what each pick was worth against the close.
price.chanceNote: Chance range: the total ± 2 standard errors. If it includes zero, the sample cannot yet tell skill from luck.
